answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a forge bet on surviving 113 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the nectar schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 113 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
